title: Telescoping identification of the weak limit (Simon 7.2 proof: T − T_{j_ℓ} = ∂R^(ℓ) + S^(ℓ) from (5))
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (Tr : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ℓ : ℕ), (∀ r ω, Tr r ω - Tr (r + 1) ω = (R r).boundary ω + S r ω) → WeaklyConvergesOn Tr T → (∀ η, HasSum (fun k => R (ℓ + k) η) (X η)) → (∀ ω, HasSum (fun k => S (ℓ + k) ω) (Y ω)) → ∀ ω, Tr ℓ ω - T ω = X.boundary ω + Y ω
